description: Money-impact proposal with trusted provenance passes the verifier under legacy trust mode. This vector intentionally exercises legacy trust mode via explicit `strict_trust=false` to isolate legacy trust='trusted' acceptance for money-impact proposals under secure-default semantics. Under the secure default (`strict_trust=true`), the same proposal is sanitized to untrusted and blocks with PIC_VERIFIER_FAILED; that behavior is covered by trust-sanitization matrix vectors. Evidence-mode verification is out of scope here.
source: adapted from tests/conftest.py money_proposal fixture (make_proposal() with defaults); exercises the rule that under legacy trust mode (explicit `strict_trust=false`), provenance.trust='trusted' is sufficient for money-impact proposals to pass the verifier
